renderingPolicy.kind: score-based synthesized performance; not a recording
renderingPolicy.tempoDisclaimer: Numeric values other than the opening 152 and Tempo I are disclosed performance choices for qualitative tempo words.
renderingPolicy.graces: Ordered 45ms notes (group capped at 180ms), before the principal unless explicitly marked after; no invented pitches.
renderingPolicy.arpeggios: Ascending roll up to 110ms, at most 22ms between notes.
renderingPolicy.pedal: Printed pedal bars and their immediate simile continuation ring to the bar boundary; open l.v. ties ring to the bar end. Key durations remain independent.
renderingPolicy.dynamicDisclaimer: Velocity levels and staccato release ratios are synthesis choices, not numerical values printed in the score.
sourceEditorialIssues: Measure 83 retains the source's [non 8va?] annotation; literal register is used.
Measure 143 normal-count 8 is inferred from unchanged 3/4 and surrounding quarter notes; only 25 is printed.
